title: Add aggregate dashboard usage history
description: Persist privacy-safe time-bucketed request and byte counters per tunnel, expose authenticated hour/day/week history through Handler -> Service -> Repository, and power a multi-series usage chart on the consolidated dashboard without storing raw request payloads.
design: Persist fixed UTC 5-minute per-tunnel counters. Repository owns aggregate and bucket writes plus owner-scoped range reads. Service aggregates hour/day/week into 5-minute/hour/day points. Authenticated GET /api/v1/dashboard/usage returns all owned tunnel series; frontend renders it in Dashboard with no separate Usage view.
acceptance_criteria: No raw request content is persisted; usage buckets are user-isolated; /api/v1/dashboard/usage supports hour/day/week; removed dashboard views fall back safely; overview chart handles empty data, range switching, theme colors, and hover details; backend and landing quality gates pass.
notes: Implemented 5-minute privacy-safe buckets, immutable tunnel-ID attribution, owner-isolated history, monotonic lifetime activity, authenticated hour/day/week API, consolidated top-10 chart, safe hash fallback, and compact dashboard layout. Validation: migration smoke test, go test/build, landing lint/tsc/build.
close_reason: Implemented and validated the aggregate dashboard usage feature and restored the pinned Next.js ESLint flat-config quality gate.

title: Build developer tunnel dashboard
description: Replace the minimal post-login screen with a responsive GoPort control plane and add real tunnel status, metadata, stop, and delete support.
close_reason: Implemented responsive dashboard, real tunnel metadata/status/actions, API wiring, and verified production builds.
